reason: Both are restaurant brand owners that serve consumers and earn franchise/license fees. Wendy's is a mass-market quick-service burger franchisor with drive-thru. The ONE Group runs mostly company-owned upscale steakhouse and teppanyaki dining (STK, Benihana, Kona Grill, RA Sushi) and also manages hotel food and beverage. The dining format, price tier and occasion differ, so this is adjacent rather than direct.
